verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at docs.termius.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that lists documentation pages as direct .md links. Many doc citations also resolve to raw Markdown URLs, such as workspaces.md and snippets.md, so an agent can be pointed at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering, no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar consolidated file, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
